messages.subject: [S] DLL file
messages.body_plain:
Dear All,

I have followed Programmers guide (SP2000, PC) to produce a
DLL file using Visual C++ 5.0, but found the instructions
given in the manual (pg 598) are incorrect. Would anyone
guide me how to make one; the example used in the book is
fibdll.c and fibdll.def which are in library/progexam.

Sincerely,
in-Sun
...
